subject: CAIQ intake: evidence curator playbook, attestation signer list, and DocuSign routing
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@aurorafin.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ evidence intake and attestation signers

Hi Irene,

Thanks for agreeing to help with our CAIQ. We completed a quick scan and marked ~45 controls as in-scope. To keep this moving on our side we need two things from Redwood: a short owner playbook for evidence intake (so our engineers know who to ping) and a list of people who can sign the attestation (we'll route via DocuSign).

Immediate asks: 
- Can you provide a one-page intake playbook (owners, expected artifacts, retention notes)?
- Share a list of signers and their roles (PDF or DocuSign-friendly).
- Attach any existing index you use for CAIQ artifacts (even a stub).

We also have a couple of live-control questions around runtime telemetry — I included them inline in the spreadsheet we tried to attach but was hitting file size limits. I can upload to the Drive link below.

Drive (incoming): https://redwood.app/drive/CAIQ-aurora-intake

Appreciate quick turnaround — Aurora audit window opens May 3.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Senior Security Manager, Aurora Financial
security@aurorafin.com

P.S. Attaching the attestation template from Aurora for reference (attestation_template.docx)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence intake and attestation signers

Hi Sam — thanks, got this.

Short plan: I'll own the intake playbook draft and we'll use a lightweight evidence index (attached) to map control IDs -> owner -> artifact types. Marissa will coordinate owner outreach for telemetry artifacts and Karthik will handle DocuSign routing/roles.

Deliverables and timeline: 
- Draft intake playbook (one page) — EOD Apr 21 (Irene)
- Evidence index (stubbed with current scope) — attached: CAIQ_evidence_index_v1.xlsx (I attached a minimal sheet already)
- Signer roster + DocuSign route plan — draft Apr 22 (Karthik)

Next steps for you: please confirm the final name(s) for Aurora signers and whether you need Redwood to countersign or merely attest by email.

I'll also include a short paragraph in the playbook about telemetry log retention and where we keep sanitized samples for auditor review.

Thanks,
Irene

Redwood Inference

Irene — looping Ben for runtime telemetry extraction and to confirm which sample logs we can share (sanitized). Ben: quick ask — can you provide a 2-paragraph excerpt we can drop into the playbook that explains how the KV cache and request tracing are retained and how we redact PII?

Also, on owners: I'm happy to triage initial outreach if you point me to the services list. We should avoid fishing expeditions — we'll ask owners for a specific artifact set per control (log snippet, policy excerpt, diagram).

Marissa

Head of Compliance Operations
